title: md-issues configuration
description: config.json in the md-issues issue directory.

lang.description: Language of messages and of the generated index. Never taken from the environment.

status.description: Allowed statuses. Replaces the default set (open, doing, deferred, done, wontfix).

label.description: Shown in the index. Defaults to a translation or the status name.

dir.description: Where issues with this status live, relative to the issue directory. "" keeps them at the top.

summary.description: Show a per-severity breakdown in the summary line.

required.description: Keys every issue must have, in addition to id, title and status.

severity.description: Allowed severities, highest first. Also the sort order of the index.

fields.description: Vocabularies of other fields: a list of allowed values or a regular expression.

columns.description: Columns of the index tables. Default: id, title, severity (when configured), status.

fields.description: Values are joined with a space.

linkFiles.description: Other files whose relative links are rewritten and checked (paths from the root; *, ** and ? allowed).

keys.description: Extra frontmatter keys issues may use. When given, any other key is an error. id, title, status, related, commits and the keys used by severity, fields, required and columns are always allowed.

openTasks.description: Statuses (for example ["done"]) whose issues must not contain unchecked task list items (- [ ]). Items in code blocks are ignored.

checkCommits.description: With `md-issues check`, verify that every hash in "commits" is a commit in the Git repository.
